title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Guidance on the Participation of People's Courts in the Operation of Comprehensive Social Security Management Centers
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on the Participation of People's Courts in the Operation of Comprehensive Social Governance Centers

Fa [2025] No. 20

To all local people's courts at various levels nationwide, all military courts at various levels, and all courts at various levels of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

The Guiding Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on the Participation of People's Courts in the Operation of Comprehensive Social Governance Centers are hereby issued. Please earnestly implement the relevant work in light of actual circumstances. In the event of any problems during implementation, promptly report them to the Supreme People's Court.

February 22, 2025

Guiding Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on the Participation of People's Courts in the Operation of Comprehensive Social Governance Centers

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 20th Central Committee, to uphold and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era, and to participate in the operation of comprehensive social governance centers (hereinafter referred to as comprehensive governance centers) based on the statutory functions of the people's courts, the following opinions are hereby put forward.

1. Fully Understand the Importance of Participating in the Operation of Comprehensive Governance Centers

The Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on Further Deepening Reform and Comprehensively Advancing the Modernization of China's Governance System and Governance Capacity, adopted at the Third Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee, made specific arrangements for improving the social governance system. Currently, social conflicts and disputes exhibit characteristics of large quantity, new types, and broad fields, with increasing difficulty in resolution. The comprehensive governance center is an important working platform based on the functions of political and legal affairs, promoting various departments to perform their duties according to law and form synergy, carrying out the prevention and resolution of conflicts and disputes, and assisting in promoting the prevention and control of social security risks. People's courts at all levels must adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for the New Era, thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, participate in the operation of comprehensive governance centers in their respective regions within the scope of their statutory functions, promote the integration of dispute resolution resources, improve online and offline linkage mechanisms, further enhance the legalization level of conflict and dispute prevention and resolution, and earnestly shoulder the responsibility and mission of safeguarding social fairness and justice as the "last line of defense."

2. Integrate Relevant Functions of the Litigation Service Center

(1) General Requirements. Grassroots people's courts shall adhere to seeking truth from facts and adapting measures to local conditions. Based on the requirements of county-level comprehensive governance centers to coordinate the relevant functions of the litigation service center, and taking into account factors such as the actual situation of the region and the operation of the county-level comprehensive governance center, they shall establish a litigation service functional area or set up a case-filing window within the comprehensive governance center. Alternatively, they may rely on information platforms to carry out docking work according to the coordinated arrangements of the comprehensive governance center. The location of the litigation service functional area or window shall be set at the back end of the comprehensive governance center.

People's tribunals may, based on the operation of township-level comprehensive governance centers, designate specific liaisons to carry out docking work through means such as "point-to-point" guidance, circuit trials, and video guidance, and make good use of the working mechanism of the people's court mediation platform "entering villages, entering communities, and entering grids," thereby enhancing the joint force for on-site prevention and resolution of conflicts and disputes.

(2) Main Tasks. People's courts within the comprehensive governance center shall primarily carry out work such as guiding mediation, explaining the law through cases, entrusting mediation, and connecting litigation with mediation. They may also provide convenient litigation services such as case-filing. In regions where conditions permit, they may carry out fast adjudication and summary procedures for simple cases.

(3) Personnel Requirements. Where people's courts, based on local conditions, select judges, judge assistants, clerks, or other judicial personnel, retired judges, or other litigation service personnel to form litigation service teams to carry out work, at least one judge shall be permanently stationed.

Judges, judge assistants, clerks, and other personnel stationed at the comprehensive governance center may be rotated.

3. Standardize the Process for Connecting Conflict and Dispute Resolution

(4) Diversion of Disputes. People's courts, in conjunction with the operation of the comprehensive governance center in their jurisdiction, shall provide explanations and guidance at external service venues such as litigation service centers and people's tribunals. After a people's court accepts a case, if it considers mediation appropriate, upon obtaining the consent of the parties, the people's court may organize pre-litigation mediation, or the comprehensive governance center may coordinate with relevant departments and working forces to jointly mediate.

(5) Guidance Mediation. The litigation service team shall provide guidance on the mediation work of other departments and working forces, regularly organize professional training, innovate guidance methods, and promote the enhancement of the mediation capabilities and levels of people's mediation, administrative mediation, and industry-specific professional mediation.

Strengthen the interpretation of the law through cases and joint guidance efforts. For members of the public who come to the comprehensive governance center, the litigation service team shall, together with other departments, strengthen mediation explanations, inform them of the advantages and characteristics of pre-litigation mediation, leverage the exemplary and guiding role of typical cases, increase the public's acceptance of pre-litigation mediation proposals, and guide the public to have the conflicts and disputes reported to the comprehensive governance center substantively resolved through mediation and other non-litigation methods.

(6) Entrusted Mediation. Where mediation by other departments and working forces of the comprehensive governance center is unsuccessful, or where the public explicitly requests mediation by the people's court, the litigation service team shall, based on the parties' willingness, either refer the matter to retired judges or other personnel for mediation, or, through the people's court mediation platform, entrust mediation to "vertical-to-vertical" unit mediation organizations or other specially invited mediation organizations or specially invited mediators of the court.

People's courts shall strictly comply with the provisions of laws and judicial interpretations regarding the procedures and time limits for entrusted mediation, prevent prolonged mediation without resolution, and strictly prohibit pressuring parties to mediate in lieu of filing a case.

(7) Connecting Litigation with Mediation. Where a mediation agreement is reached through pre-litigation mediation at the comprehensive governance center, the parties shall be guided to perform voluntarily and on the spot; where an application for judicial confirmation may be made in accordance with laws and judicial interpretations, the stationed judge or trial team shall, after review, confirm the mediation agreement according to law and urge the debtor to perform in a timely manner.

Where mediation by other departments and working forces of the comprehensive governance center fails to reach a mediation agreement and a party initiates litigation to the people's court, the people's court shall, if the conditions for filing the case are met, accept the case according to law and then conduct simplified and complex case diversion based on whether the case involves clear facts, definite rights and obligations, and minor disputes. The stationed judge or trial team may carry out mediation, fast adjudication, and summary procedure work at the comprehensive governance center.

4. Strengthen Supporting Safeguards

(8) Strengthen Organizational Leadership. People's courts at all levels shall attach great importance to participating in the operation of comprehensive governance centers, earnestly study work plans for their respective regions, and select personnel with high political quality, strong mass work capabilities, and outstanding professional competence to carry out permanent station work. Higher and intermediate people's courts shall strengthen overall guidance for the docking work of grassroots people's courts and their dispatched people's tribunals.

(9) Improve Working Mechanisms. The litigation service team of the people's court shall strictly implement systems such as the post responsibility system for litigation service personnel, standardized service system, one-time notification system, and civil reception system, while also strengthening the connection of work with various departments of the comprehensive governance center.

(10) Enhance Service Support Levels. People's courts, based on actual circumstances, shall connect the court system's dedicated data network and the internet to the comprehensive governance center, equip necessary office equipment such as computers and printers, and provide support for the litigation service team to carry out conflict and dispute resolution and litigation services. At the same time, within the litigation service functional area or window of the comprehensive governance center, provide URLs or QR codes for information platforms such as the "People's Court Mediation Platform" and "People's Court Online Services," post flowcharts for handling litigation matters, and place mediation guidance materials, model texts for element-based complaints and defenses, etc., to facilitate the public in resolving conflicts and disputes according to law.
